sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What should your eyes follow closely when trying to catch a ball?
options: A) The ground
B) The movement of the ball
C) The sky
D) Your teammates' shoes
questions.answer: B) The movement of the ball

questions.question_text: Which part of the foot is best for accurately passing a soccer ball to a teammate?
options: A) The heel
B) The toe
C) The inside of the foot
D) The bottom sole
questions.answer: C) The inside of the foot

questions.question_text: What object do you strike with a racket when playing badminton?
options: A) A shuttlecock
B) A tennis ball
C) A leather ball
D) A plastic disc

questions.question_text: Why do we take 'little steps' while preparing to catch or hit a ball?
options: A) To make noise on the ground
B) To adjust our body position quickly
C) To rest our leg muscles
D) To confuse the opposite team
questions.answer: B) To adjust our body position quickly

questions.question_text: When throwing a ball far overhand, where should your throwing arm finish its movement?
options: A) Straight up in the air
B) Pointing directly behind you
C) Stopped suddenly at your chest
D) Across the opposite side of your body
questions.answer: D) Across the opposite side of your body

questions.question_text: How should your hands be shaped when catching a ball that is falling below your waist?
options: A) Hands apart by your sides
B) Thumbs pointing down and apart
C) Pinky fingers together forming a bowl
D) Fists closed tightly
questions.answer: C) Pinky fingers together forming a bowl

questions.question_text: What is the correct and most basic way to hold a badminton racket?
options: A) Like shaking hands with the handle
B) Gripping it with two hands tightly
C) Holding it upside down by the neck
D) Pinching it with just two fingers
questions.answer: A) Like shaking hands with the handle

questions.question_text: What is an important rule when dribbling a basketball to keep it under control?
options: A) Bounce it higher than your head
B) Keep the ball bouncing waist-high or lower
C) Slap the ball as hard as possible
D) Close your eyes while bouncing
questions.answer: B) Keep the ball bouncing waist-high or lower

questions.question_text: Which basic movement skill requires you to swing your arms opposite to your leg movements?
options: A) Standing still
B) Sitting comfortably
C) Running forward
D) Rolling on the floor

questions.question_text: Before starting a fast-paced sport, what is the best way to prepare your body?
options: A) Drinking a large amount of cold water
B) Doing light jogging and little steps
C) Sitting completely still for five minutes
D) Eating a heavy meal
questions.answer: B) Doing light jogging and little steps

questions.question_text: Explain how to properly grip a badminton racket before striking a shuttlecock. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To hold a badminton racket properly, use a handshake grip. Keep your fingers wrapped lightly around the handle with your thumb resting comfortably on the wider flat side.

questions.question_text: Describe the correct body stance when preparing to catch a high-flying ball. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: When catching a high ball, keep your eyes on it, raise both hands like a basket above your chest, and bring the ball into your body safely.

questions.question_text: Explain the correct technique for passing a soccer ball using the inside of your foot. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To kick a ball accurately, place your non-kicking foot beside the ball. Swing your kicking leg firmly and strike the middle of the ball with the inside of your foot.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of taking 'little steps' right before sprinting or receiving a pass? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Taking little steps helps you keep your body balanced and ready to change direction quickly. It prepares your leg muscles for suddenly running faster during a sports match.

questions.question_text: Why is the 'follow-through' motion important after you throw a ball forward? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: After throwing a ball, your arm should follow through by continuing its downward motion across your body. This helps increase throwing speed and keeps the ball moving straight.

questions.question_text: Describe the proper sequence of movements for serving a shuttlecock accurately over the net in badminton. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: To serve a shuttlecock, stand sideways with your feet apart for balance. Hold the shuttlecock by its feathers in one hand and drop it slightly in front of you. Swing the racket underarm smoothly to hit the cork over the net.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are a goalkeeper in a soccer match waiting for an opponent to kick. Describe your ready posture. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: As a goalkeeper, I would stand with my knees slightly bent and feet shoulder-width apart. I would keep my weight on the balls of my feet, bend forward slightly, and hold both hands up, ready to dive or catch the moving ball quickly.

questions.question_text: Explain the complete physical action of kicking a stationary ball strongly towards a specific target. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To kick a ball accurately towards a target, start by taking a few running steps backward. Run up and plant your non-kicking foot firmly next to the ball. Swing your kicking leg back, lock your ankle, and strike the ball's center with your shoelaces, following through towards the target for power.

questions.question_text: Describe the safe and coordinated way to pass a baton to a teammate during a relay sprint race. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To pass a relay baton smoothly, the runner arriving must hold the baton firmly and shout a signal like 'Go!'. The receiving runner should start running forward, reach their hand back with the palm open, and firmly grab the baton without dropping it or slowing down the team's running pace.
